data.description: Board request (chat DM @human:forrest, msg 118, 2026-08-30 17:49), verbatim: "also, we should be able to pin employees in the DM list section, then otherwise sort them by team prefix." Interpretation left to the planner, with hints: pinning is a per-viewer preference (localStorage is the established per-viewer store — identity already lives there); "team prefix" most cheaply reads as the actor-id role prefix (developer-, qa-, pm-, ceo-, cto-), though personnel frontmatter also carries a team: field via apps/chat/lib/personnel.js (AS-8) — planner picks one and says why. Touches the AS-8 roster/DM sidebar rendering.
data.title: Chat: pin employees in the DM sidebar; sort unpinned DMs by team prefix

data.body: Bumped low->medium per board DM msg 160 ('all the chat UX improvements'). Runs last in the UX queue: it restyles the same DM sidebar AS-23 collapses into a drawer on mobile — landing it after AS-23 avoids doing the sidebar work twice.

Plan written (cto-owen). Decisions: (1) pin state in localStorage keyed per identity — chat.pins.<me>, JSON array, try/catch degradation, no backend/export impact (UI preference, house chat.me precedent); (2) 'team prefix' = actor-id role prefix (agent:developer-marcus -> developer) not frontmatter team: — matches the verbatim naming convention, total over both sidebar lists incl. non-roster DMs and roster-degradation fallback, no parser-contract coupling; groups lexicographic, name tie-break; (3) pinned roster rows float to top sorted by the same comparator (deterministic, no drag-order); pins scoped to roster rows only, #dm-list gets the comparator but no pin affordance; (4) always-visible touch-first star toggle per row (post-AS-23), stopPropagation so it never opens the DM, aria-pressed; (5) ordering is a pure function of state so push badge bumps and the 60s reconcile can never shuffle rows. New pure module public/dm-sort.js + test/dm-sort.test.js per house extraction pattern; server/API/URL-state untouched; existing suites byte-identical.
